operations.content: Hermes 'mcp add' keeps only the LAST --env flag when repeated; to set multiple env vars use repeated 'hermes config set mcp_servers.NAME.env.KEY value' calls instead, then 'hermes mcp test NAME' to verify.

Tavily rotator (F:/CD/Opencode/.opencode/tools/tavily-rotator) exposes tavily-search/extract/crawl/map/usage only, no research tool; official Tavily MCP is search+extract only. Default search depth follows TAVILY_DEFAULT_DEPTH env (else basic);-rotator caps chunks_per_source at 3 per Tavily API limit and shares state file tavily-state.json across agents.
